item.title: The Game Awards Announces Game of the Year 2026 Nominees
item.description: After months of anticipation and constant speculation , we finally know what games will duke it out for the top prize at The Game Awards 2026 . Organizers for the biggest night in gaming announced this year's nominees for Game of the Year , and all the other categories, during a livestream on Tuesday, Nov. 17.

item.title: Magic: The Gathering Designer Reveals a ‘Mind-Blowing’ Detail About Netflix’s New Series
item.description: Netflix first announced it was working on a Magic: The Gathering TV series in 2019, and the project has been trapped in development hell ever since, passed between three different creative teams . Now Planeswalker is finally set to debut in 2027, and Wizards of the Coast shared a first look during a preview panel at MagicCon: Atlanta 2026 . While the trailer introduced the young pyromancer Chandra Nalaar and her mentor Ajani Goldmane, Magic: The Gathering vice president of design Aaron Forsythe told Polygon in an interview at MagicCon that this won’t be a typical hero’s journey story.

item.title: Critical Role's Newest Campaign Officially Gets a Release Date and Cast Announcement
item.description: Critters are in for a treat in 2027, with Critical Role ’s brand-new Daggerheart miniseries, Reign of the Weredragon , premiering on Wednesday, Jan. 13 at 3 p.m. PT.

item.title: Robert Pattinson’s James Bond Will Be ‘an Assassin,’ Director Says
item.description: Director Denis Villeneuve's upcoming James Bond has finally found its 007. On Monday, Amazon MGM Studios announced Robert Pattinson will be donning the tux and wearing the gadget-infused watch as the seventh big-screen Bond.

item.title: Mass Effect Spiritual Successor Exodus Finally Reveals Female Protagonist
item.description: Exodus has been one of the most interesting games to watch since its announcement. The spiritual successor to Mass Effect, developed by BioWare veterans at Archetype Entertainment, Exodus has positioned itself as the perfect replacement for the beloved sci-fi RPG series after EA's tragic closure of BioWare . Yet one feature Archetype has failed to showcase, despite intense fan demand, is the game's female protagonist. Well, the wait is finally over.

item.title: New GTA 6 Screenshots Show Off A Crucial Next-Gen Feature
item.description: With release just a couple of days away, Rockstar's marketing for Grand Theft Auto 6 has officially gone into hyperdrive. In addition to collaborations with entire cities , basketball teams , clothing brands , and South Park, the brand has also begun a partnership with something you'd never expect: The Weather Channel. It's unusual, but also a perfect opportunity to showcase GTA 6 's enhanced weather system.

item.title: Marvel’s Rumored Iceman Actor Plays Coy About X-Men Casting
item.description: After what feels like years of waiting, Marvel is finally setting the stage to bring the X-Men into the MCU fold. That process took a major step forward this year with Jean Grey's appearance in Spider-Man: Brand New Day , followed by a number of cast announcements for a new movie during the D23 Expo . There are still plenty of iconic mutants left to officially be revealed for the movie, however, and rumors are always swirling.

item.title: One of the Switch 2’s Best Exclusives Just Got a Free Demo
item.description: Get your Splattershots ready. Nintendo just released a new demo for Splatoon Raiders , the single-player-focused Splatoon spin-off that came out earlier this year. “A demo version of Splatoon Raiders is now available on Nintendo Switch 2!” reads a post from Splatoon’s X account . “Get a taste of the Spirhalite Islands with 3 different stages, and team up with Deep Cut to take 3 preselected loadouts for a test splat.”

item.title: Game of Thrones Creators' Sci-Fi Thriller Officially Returns With New Trailer
item.description: After nearly three years, Netflix's hard sci-fi series 3 Body Problem is finally returning . On Tuesday, Netflix revealed a first look at 3 Body Problem season 2 in the form of a very expensive-looking teaser trailer and a handful of new stills from the series, which herald the arrival of the destructive aliens known as the San-Ti. The cosmic war between humanity and its would-be exterminators is coming, and it looks spectacular.

item.title: Marvel Boss Officially Reveals Why Avengers Switched from Kang to Doctor Doom
item.description: Avengers: Doomsday is a month away and will find the Avengers , the New Avengers , and X-Men from the Fox films facing off against Robert Downey Jr.'s Doctor Doom . Originally, the fifth Avengers film was titled The Kang Dynasty and would have starred Jonathan Majors as Kang , who appeared in Loki and Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania . Marvel fired him in December 2023 after he was convicted on assault and harassment charges, and retooled The Kang Dynasty into the Doctor Doom-centric Doomsday .
